Q: 404 This page could not be found. Nextjs Link A:

The issue is that creating a React component alone doesn't create a route in Next.js.

If you want /ab to be a route, you need to create an ab folder inside the app directory and add a page.js (or page.tsx) file that renders your component.

For example:

app/
├── page.js
└── ab/
    └── page.js

Then in app/ab/page.js:

import Ab from '@/components/Ab';

export default function Page() {
  return <Ab />;
}

Now <Link href="/ab"> will correctly navigate to /ab.

A component such as ab.js by itself is not automatically treated as a route by Next.js.

Q: Collapsing blank cell values in Tablix A:

You can conditionaly hide rows by turning the visibility off in the row group based on a value.

Q: Limit table growth horizontally but not vertically in SSRS A:

I've had the same issue before. The way I resolved it was to add a column to "Table 1" outside the group to the right. Then increase the width of the new column to fill all the dead space all the way to the start of "Table 2". After that, right click the column and set the visibility to false.

If you want to paste the XML code from the RDL file, I can mock it up for you. Right click the RDL file and view as text.
